readiness_question: Are source principal schema version classification and idempotency key explicit?
Does replaying the same event avoid a second side effect?
Can provider failure queue fail over or stop safely?
Can untrusted content alter system authority or policy?
Are tools resources and actions denied unless explicitly granted?
Is approval bound to the exact action hash principal and expiry?
Do hard per-run and per-period limits stop execution?
Are credentials kept outside model context and logs?
Are external effects journaled before retry or resume?
Can concurrent writers detect or prevent conflicting mutation?
Does evaluation evidence justify each model route by task risk?
Does resumed execution preserve original scope and constraints?
Do artifact-specific checks reject known-bad output?
Does failed verification leave the original resource intact?
Has restoration been executed within the recovery objective?
Does every irreversible external effect require the configured approval?
Can one trace reconstruct request policy plan checks and effect receipt?
Are synthetic checks SLOs alerts owners and runbooks active?
Do logs enforce redaction access and retention rules?
Can an unverified lesson alter policy prompts or executable code?
Does every release compare stable metrics with a baseline?
